Shotgun metagenomics · rat caecum

Atlas of gut microbiome disturbances following glyphosate & Roundup exposure

A compositional (CLR) analysis of how glyphosate and its formulation Roundup, across low and high doses, reshape the caecal microbiome — bacteria, fungi, viruses, antibiotic-resistance genes, virulence factors and functional pathways — relative to control.

Study at a glance

Each treatment group (n=12) is compared against the control group (CONT, n=12). Two single-replicate sequencing controls (PC, NC) are excluded from group statistics. Doses: 0.5 mg/kg bw/day (US ADI) and 50 mg/kg bw/day (EU NOAEL); MIX = a glyphosate-based mixture.

Where the disturbances are

Number of significantly altered features (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR < 0.20) in each data layer for every treatment-vs-control contrast. Brighter = more disruption. Click a cell to open it in the differential atlas.

nonefewseveralmany

Community-level shifts

Aitchison (CLR-Euclidean) ordination shows whether whole communities separate by exposure; PERMANOVA tests it formally. Shannon diversity summarises within-sample richness/evenness.

Methods

Atlas of gut microbiome disturbances following glyphosate & Roundup exposure · Compositional analysis (CLR + Welch + Benjamini-Hochberg).
Data: PRJNA609596 · Generated from shotgun metagenomic abundance tables. Statistical results are exploratory and intended for hypothesis generation.
